# Owner decisions needed to close layer 3 (L3-R2)

MESHSAT-1357, 30 September 2026. The only decisions layer 3 still needs from the owner, one row each, from `v2/docs/handover/layer3/l3r2.yaml`; every figure is a model or desk result of the records named on `L3-RECONCILIATION.md`, not a measurement, and nothing here is drawn, built or tested. A recommendation is the session's and is not an approval (D-21): each row stays AWAITING until the owner's own words decide it. Rows L3-OD1, L3-OD2 and L3-OD4 are HELD by the owner's review of the draft table (D-22), and row L3-OD6's recommendation and figures by his instruction on this table (D-23), until the corrected, independently checked energy comparison is filed (open item S-127); their energy cells state no figure before it, and no case is called typical or adverse until the basis names each by its exact weather and operating assumptions. Each row gives its options (an option that cannot meet mission M1, or rests on something no record establishes, is flagged in capitals), the session's recommendation, quantified consequences with their evidence linked, and its dependencies (D-23).

Changes to weather coverage, deployment restrictions, functionality, operating conditions or enclosure constraints are proposals for the owner's explicit decision (D-22, D-23): each appears only as a row or an option he answers, never as a closure, and none is taken because the current design passes it.

## Board A's current-limit resistor R11: the held circuit and the proposed change

Every Option A(i) energy result depends on board A's front-end shunt R11 (fact CF-02 of `L3-RECONCILIATION.md`). Each row's result on the circuit as generated and the result conditional on the drafted re-rate are two columns, never one figure (D-23). The change's implementation and its physical verification are downstream obligations tracked apart (closure items L3-C34 and L3-C35), not layer 3 prerequisites.

| Row | Held circuit: R11 10 mOhm, as generated | Conditional on the drafted R11 6.2 mOhm |
|---|---|---|
| L3-OD1 | M1 NOT MET with any lid, by 326 to 523 Wh (fact CF-02) | HELD for the checked energy basis (S-127) |
| L3-OD2 | no lid meets M1 (fact CF-02) | each lid HELD for the checked energy basis (S-127) |
| L3-OD4 | no band: no lid meets M1 (fact CF-02) | the band HELD for the checked energy basis (S-127) |
| L3-OD6 | no store figure: no lid meets M1 on the held circuit (fact CF-02) | every option's figures HELD for the checked energy basis (S-127) |

## Applying an answer

Each row has a prepared registry restatement, not applied: `python3 v2/docs/records/l3r2/conditional/<script> --option <option> --words "<the owner's words>" --date <YYYY-MM-DD>` records his answer as an owner ruling that names the row and applies the exact registry change; `--check` does the same in memory and writes nothing. A row whose `requires` is not met is refused. After a script: `rules_lib.py requirements`, `rules_render.py --requirements` and this renderer.

|---|---|---|---|---|

| L3-OD2 | `od_l3_2.py` | `qmx-out`; `qmx-outside` (also held until `relocation_facts`); `tablet-out`; `both-kept` | L3-OD1:approve | l3r2.yaml `energy_basis` filed |
| L3-OD3 | `od_l3_3.py` | `2s2p`; `1s4p`; `keep` | L3-OD1:approve | nothing |

## The combinations the evidence covers

The prepared scripts refuse a combination outside these rules, and the completion gate reads the target unambiguous only on one inside them (CHECK-1, B1).

| Rule | Why |
|---|---|
| row L3-OD1 answered approve | rows L3-OD2 to L3-OD4 need it; a reject records an open conflict instead |
| row L3-OD4 answered adopt only with row L3-OD3 answered 2s2p | the plane grid ran 400 Wp in 2S2P into 200 W; no band exists for 1S4P or for REQ-016 kept |
| row L3-OD4 answered adopt only with row L3-OD2 not answered both-kept | M1 is not met with a 4S9P lid, so no band is adopted for it |
| row L3-OD4 answered adopt only with row L3-OD6 not answered coverage | the plane grid runs SC-37's mean day on each plane; no band exists for a coverage target |
| one ruling on the array | row L3-OD1 fixes no array; row L3-OD3 alone does, and od_l3_3.py replaces REQ-072's marked phrase with it |
